intent: Import transactions from a CSV file into my account.
actions: Start in a local account with no saved CSV import settings.
Click Import and select a semicolon-delimited CSV statement containing three transactions followed by two summary rows.
Select the semicolon delimiter and wait for the preview to refresh.
Map Posting to Date and Value to Amount, choose DD.MM.YYYY, and check Flip amount.
Review the five visible preview rows, including the two invalid summary rows, with Skip end lines set to 0.
Change Skip end lines to 2 and wait for the preview to refresh.
